description: Explain a fragrance note or perfume ingredient: what it smells like, its family and mood, where it comes from, which notes it pairs with, similar notes, famous perfumes where it leads and a link to the 10ML note page or guide when one exists. Covers about 285 notes in many spellings and languages. Use for 'what does ambroxan smell like', 'what is oud', 'what goes with bergamot', 'is iso e super a note'. Not for listing every perfume with the note (use perfumes_by_note) and not for general terms like EDP or sillage (use explain_perfume_term).

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

name: explain_note
title: Explain a fragrance note
